title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: In a land where ash falls from the sky and an immortal ruler has held power for a thousand years, a crew of thieves plots to overthrow him. Their newest recruit, a street girl, discovers she can use a rare kind of metal-based magic.
readIf: you like a heist-style fantasy with an inventive magic system and a satisfying, twisty plot.
skipIf: you want lyrical prose or a slow character study, as the writing is plain and plot-driven.

pairings.reason: Another fantasy about a crew of clever criminals with a long con, but more foul-mouthed and funny.
A similar crew-and-heist adventure, shorter and aimed at a younger readership.
The same author's much longer, slower and even bigger epic.
